retirement_age.notes: The standard retirement age (Regelaltersgrenze) rises gradually from 65 to 67 between 2012 and 2029; people born in 1964 or later have a standard retirement age of 67.

open_questions: Next Bundestag election: no exact date set yet. Sources state it must be held on or before 2029-03-25 (possible Sundays 2029-01-28 to 2029-03-25); the president sets the date. Date left null.

Steinmeier's exact term end date was not found in an official source, so term_ends is null. He began a second term after re-election on 2022-02-13; the Federal Convention to elect his successor is reported for 2027-01-30, and he cannot seek a third term.
Chancellor has no fixed term (office depends on the Bundestag). A government crisis around Merz was reported in 2026; his status should be re-checked at the next refresh.
